answer: The forge index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes an adversary to the back of the gale queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier keep earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 856 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the juniper. A farm of 261 pays that 163 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
